title: 🤖 LeRobot Trains on Lance, 🦾 Mining Robot Fleet Data Demo, 🔍 Vector Search at 10B Scale
summary: LeRobot trains directly from Lance datasets in object storage, a hybrid scan mines robot fleet data for edge cases, and distributed search reaches 1,066 QPS across 10B vectors, plus upcoming events, enterprise updates, and community contributions.
body_markdown:
## 🗽 LanceDB Featured in Times Square


Thank you to **Microsoft for Startups** for featuring LanceDB as part of its invite-only Pegasus Program! We joined Pegasus earlier this year as we continue building the new foundation for AI data.


## 🤖 How To Train Your Robot: The LanceDB Edition


LeRobot now reads Lance datasets natively, so training pulls frames straight from object storage with a true global shuffle and no download. On all of DROID (27.6M frames, 369 GB), 10k SmolVLA steps on 8 H100s took 1h27m vs 2h00m for the standard reader on a local NVMe copy, with identical loss. GPUs waited on data 1.7% of the time vs 37.4%.


[Read more →](https://huggingface.co/blog/CarolinePascal/how-to-train-your-robot-the-lancedb-edition)


## 🎥 Train on the Right Data: Mining a Robot Fleet with LanceDB


Finding fleet moments that resemble a robot's edge case is hard when data is organized by episode instead of time step. Follow the full loop on DROID: store each of 32,212 time steps as a row with pixels, proprioception, physics, and instruction, add DINOv2 embeddings at ingest, run one hybrid vector and full-text scan instead of a post-filter, and save the result as a versioned training slice.


[Watch the demo →](https://youtu.be/OVxZ0NjXFYo)


## 🔍 From 10 Million to 10 Billion: Vector Search Built to Grow


Five-bit RaBitQ hit 96.2% recall at 1,614 QPS on 10M 768d vectors, vs 91.5% for PQ384 at 1,047 QPS. At 10B vectors, distributed search held an 18.05 ms p50 and reached 1,066 QPS at 256 concurrent requests. A one-bit distance bound prunes over 99% of candidates before full scoring, and switching from fast to normal at query time lifts recall from 75.0% to 93.1% with no index rebuild.


[Read more →](https://www.lancedb.com/blog/10-billion-vector-search)

## 🌟 Open Source Releases


Project Description


**Lance** v12.0.0
[Release notes](https://github.com/lance-format/lance/releases) • **Breaking:** namespace` merge_insert` takes a list of key columns for composite-key upserts, a Rust API change ([#8915](https://github.com/lance-format/lance/pull/8915) );` json_extract` predicates no longer route to JSON indices and fall back to a full scan ([#9101](https://github.com/lance-format/lance/pull/9101) )
• **IVF index improvements:** Shared partition scans across batch vector queries ([#7640](https://github.com/lance-format/lance/pull/7640) ), proportional hierarchical k-means for training ([#9050](https://github.com/lance-format/lance/pull/9050) ), automatic partition splitting/joining in single optimize pass ([#9051](https://github.com/lance-format/lance/pull/9051) ), and metric-aware initial probe budgets ([#9195](https://github.com/lance-format/lance/pull/9195) )
• **Full-text search performance:** Deferred phrase confirmation with score bounds ([#8749](https://github.com/lance-format/lance/pull/8749) ), bulk intersection for wide AND queries ([#9030](https://github.com/lance-format/lance/pull/9030) ), and bounded classic conjunction scoring ([#9033](https://github.com/lance-format/lance/pull/9033) )
• **Row ID performance:** Fragment reuse indexes open 10–2200× faster ([#8887](https://github.com/lance-format/lance/pull/8887) ); cached row ID index with ranked bitmap lookups ([#8930](https://github.com/lance-format/lance/pull/8930) )
• **Python API additions:**` LanceDataset.slice()` method ([#8059](https://github.com/lance-format/lance/pull/8059) ),` Bitmap` binding for RoaringBitmap ([#7837](https://github.com/lance-format/lance/pull/7837) ), custom` ObjectStoreProvider` registration ([#8522](https://github.com/lance-format/lance/pull/8522) ), and dataset deep clone ([#9181](https://github.com/lance-format/lance/pull/9181) )


**LanceDB** v0.39.0
[Release notes](https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/releases) • **Breaking:** materialized views can carry function-bound computed columns ([#4119](https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4119) ), and refreshing a computed column now recomputes rows whose inputs or definition changed instead of only filling nulls ([#4161](https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4161) )
• Remote connections run SQL synchronously or in the background with` execute_query` /` execute_query_async` ([#4070](https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4070) )
• **Breaking:**` get_job` /` job_history` are replaced by` open_job` ,` describe_job` , and` query_job_events` , which expose per-fragment progress and failure info ([#4130](https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4130) )
• Function management APIs expanded:` drop_function` ,` list_functions` , support for nested blob signatures and nullable named outputs ([#4097](https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4097) ,[#4108](https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4108) ,[#4109](https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4109) ,[#4123](https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4123) )


**lance-namespace** v0.12.0 – v0.13.0
[Release notes](https://github.com/lance-format/lance-namespace/releases) • Merge insert operations now support multiple columns as the merge key ([#363](https://github.com/lance-format/lance-namespace/pull/363) ) — breaking change to the spec
• Added adaptive IVF probe query fields for dynamic tuning of vector index searches ([#367](https://github.com/lance-format/lance-namespace/pull/367) )


**lance-context** v0.6.6 – v0.6.7
[Release notes](https://github.com/lance-format/lance-context/releases) • Bounded memory for WAL-backed rollout pagination ([#230](https://github.com/lance-format/lance-context/pull/230) ), large-blob compaction ([#229](https://github.com/lance-format/lance-context/pull/229) ), MemWAL merges via` ROLLOUT_MERGE_MAX_BYTES` ([#242](https://github.com/lance-format/lance-context/pull/242) ), and Context point-reads with deferred payload loading ([#243](https://github.com/lance-format/lance-context/pull/243) )
• New blob-size histogram metric and warning logs for oversized blobs to help diagnose storage patterns ([#240](https://github.com/lance-format/lance-context/pull/240) )
• Fixed scheduler starvation where` MergeWal` could block` Compact` operations ([#239](https://github.com/lance-format/lance-context/pull/239) )


## 🫶 Community Contributions


Thank you to contributors from Bytedance, Baidu, Adobe, Huawei, Tencent, DeepL, LumaLabs for improvements across storage, indexing, query execution, distributed processing, and ecosystem integrations in LanceDB, Lance, and the broader ecosystem.


**Notable contributions this month:**


- [@summaryzb](https://github.com/summaryzb) — Java scan APIs can now target specific vector index segments, so distributed vector search can split a query across workers by segment
- [@sezruby](https://github.com/sezruby) — Batched vector queries now read each probed IVF partition once and score every query against it, and added a Java batch vector search binding
- [@jiaoew1991](https://github.com/jiaoew1991) — Sped up row-ID and scan paths: streaming dataset version runs with a cursor, faster dense bitmap decoding, less system-column pipeline overhead, and single-producer Python reader batches
- [@dshepelev15](https://github.com/dshepelev15) — Kept the row-ID index cached with ranked bitmap lookups (get 422 to 126 ns on a 17.4B-row table), and cut object-store requests by batching page reads and reading large metadata in concurrent chunks
- [@zhangyue19921010](https://github.com/zhangyue19921010) — Added an experimental MinHash LSH scalar index for Jaccard text similarity across Rust, Python, and Java, plus matched-row offsets from` update_columns` and removal of an O(C²) commit validation step
- [@jonasdedden](https://github.com/jonasdedden) — Fixed Python API annotations (CompactionOptions,` create_index_uncommitted` , a misspelled option) and decoded deprecated substrait timestamp literals as microseconds
- [@wombatu-kun](https://github.com/wombatu-kun) — Widened the RaBitQ FastScan accumulator so distances above 1024 rotated dims no longer overflow, and kept commits working when an existing index can't be opened
- [@LuciferYang](https://github.com/LuciferYang) — About 30 hardening fixes across indexing and query paths, including rejecting malformed IVF/PQ/RaBitQ metadata instead of panicking, -0.0/0.0 float filter equality, Float16 literal coercion, and merge_insert routing fixes
- [@ddupg](https://github.com/ddupg) — Restored Python index retraining, aligned Java inverted index options with Rust, and pruned scalar index segments outside the queried fragments

## 🤝 Lance Community Sync Recap


The Lance 12.0.0 SDK ships with the Lance 2.2 file format as the default, and this month's syncs covered the 11.0.0 and 12.0.0 releases alongside a governance change to PR-based voting. Design discussion centered on a production-ready redesign of stable row IDs, Transactions V2, a proposal to narrow Lance's core scope, and a separate proposal for a tiered manifest structure. The community also worked through the format proposal backlog and better ways for teams building on Lance to upstream their changes.


The next Lance Community Sync will take place on **Thursday, October 9 @ 9am PT** .
